Markdown to PDF

Paste or open your Markdown, then tap ••• at the top right and .pdf under export. Rapier writes the PDF in your browser: nothing is uploaded. The text stays searchable, and the Markdown travels inside the PDF, so Rapier can open it again as the same Markdown.

Also: Markdown to Word · Free online Markdown editor

Questions

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.

Is my file uploaded?

No. Rapier works in your browser. Local editing uploads nothing.

Can I add a page break?

Yes. Tap + on the bar under the text, then Line.

Do tables, code and math come through?

Yes, with pictures, drawings and diagrams, as they look on the page.

Open, save and export

Open Markdown, text, code, Word, TextPack or PDF files. A Word document becomes an editable page, pictures and everything. A PDF comes in as text when possible.

Rapier keeps a draft as you work, so a closed app or tab keeps your work for a while. Press Save often to keep it properly.

Under the three dots, Copy, Share and Export send your work as text, PDF, Word or an offline web page that opens on any device, and Rapier can open it again for editing.

Share → HTML editor makes a .rapier.html file with Rapier inside. Open it offline, edit, save and send it back.
